title: LeakLatch leak event (PipeGen -> FirmGen)
description: Published by PipeGen on leaklatch/{site_id}/zone/{zone_id}/event (QoS 1, not retained). One message per detection, periodic update, or clear. Every message has a fresh event_id; messages belonging to one pooling incident share incident_id.

event_id.description: Unique per message (UUID4 hex). FirmGen de-duplicates on it.

timestamp.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds and Z suffix.

pool_area.description: Floor area covered by pooled water inside the zone, square metres (perspective-corrected when the zone has a homography).

growth_rate.description: Least-squares slope of pool_area over the tracking window, square metres per minute. Negative = shrinking.

snapshot.description: Path of the annotated JPEG kept on the edge device.
